rows.title: Ramona Again
notes: “First up from Western Australia, something new from R.R. Viper, a song called Ramona Again.”
New 2026 single from this Fremantle, WA post-surf/punk five-piece, ahead of their second album 'Ra Ra' (out 18 Sept 2026).

rows.title: Keeping Warm
notes: “also from Perth, something new from Michael Gabriel and the Quixotics. A song from them called Keeping Warm.”
Fifth single (released 4 Sept 2026) from this Perth/Fremantle band, previewing their upcoming album 'Desdemona'.

rows.title: Corridors of Power
notes: “Bruce had requested The Hitmen doing Corridors of Power.”
Classic track by the Sydney punk/hard-rock band (Johnny Kannis, Chris Masuak), from their 1984 live farewell album 'Tora Tora D.T.K.'

rows.title: Dissatisfaction
notes: “This is a song he recorded with his band The Last Drinks And it's called Dissatisfaction”
Track from the 2003/04 album 'Ashes & Wine' by ex-Golden Rough frontman Jason Walker with his band The Last Drinks.
